original_text: <!-- (Audio) Maria: Then, on Wednesdays, I go to a local theater group. Practice goes until 9. We perform small plays. It's really fun. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Maria: Zatim, sredama idem u lokalnu pozorišnu grupu. Vežbanje traje do devet. Izvodimo male predstave. Zaista je zabavno. -->
